copy.scene_summary: Jason and Lucia on a heist, chases and the city

shots.text: Here's five crazy things you can do in GTA 6 that you could never do in GTA 5.
Number one: you can rob places as a duo. Jason and Lucia split the job, and it actually feels like Bonnie and Clyde.
Number two: the masks matter now. Put one on before the job and the cops get no description.
But wait till you see what happens when the getaway goes wrong.
Number three: you can switch to whoever's riding shotgun mid-chase. Would you drive, or shoot?
